parties.petitioner: AC CHOKSHI SHARE BROKER PRIVATE LIMITED

summary: Arbitration jurisdiction over non-contracting spouse; joint liability via oral agreement; Bye-law 248(a) BSE interpretation; credit balance transfer validity; Section 34/37 scope; arbitral award upheld; High Court reversal on jurisdictional grounds overturned; husband's liability sustained for wife's trading account debit balance.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned High Court order set aside; arbitral award restored in its entirety; respondents held jointly and severally liable.
